requiredSecrets.name: DROPLET_HOST
requiredSecrets.meaning: Production droplet host name or IP address used by the backup SSH step.

requiredSecrets.name: DROPLET_USER
requiredSecrets.meaning: SSH user on the production droplet.

requiredSecrets.name: DROPLET_SSH_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Private SSH key matching the droplet user's authorized public key.
requiredSecrets.safeExample: -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY----- ... -----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

requiredSecrets.name: SPACES_BUCKET
requiredSecrets.meaning: DigitalOcean Spaces bucket that stores PostgreSQL backup artifacts.

requiredSecrets.name: SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.meaning: DigitalOcean Spaces access key id with write access to the backup prefix.

requiredSecrets.name: SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: DigitalOcean Spaces secret access key paired with SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

requiredSecrets.name: BACKUP_POSTGRES_USER
requiredSecrets.meaning: PostgreSQL role used by pg_dump inside the production database container.

requiredSecrets.name: BACKUP_POSTGRES_DB
requiredSecrets.meaning: Production PostgreSQL database name to dump.

requiredSecrets.name: BACKUP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD
requiredSecrets.meaning: Password passed to pg_dump through PGPASSWORD inside docker exec.
